facts:
## CELL FACTS

Cell 水_正印 (Water carrying The Sage). Persona The Sage (正印). Definition line: "Nourishment that deepens without redirecting, the root that holds". Keyword Care, charge gentle, poles catalyst Wisdom / friction Comfort. Family function: Mind. Cost dimension: the root that holds; shelter that can become stillness. Arena: roots, old trees, the deep well, inherited warmth. Classical portrait: shelter and nourishment that deepens without redirecting; over-protection, "not ready yet" as a place to stay. Ruled domains: Knowledge, Shelter, Nurture. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 偏印.
Element arena: Water (depth, current, tide, rain, spring, flow). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Wood. structural_interaction seed: "Water generating Wood cross-polarity — depth nourishing reach and opening form".
- k2_overview: "Your Water moves as the Sage: the source spring, nourishment that never announces itself. Care flows from you the way aquifers feed valleys, invisibly, constantly, taken for granted precisely because it never fails. You absorb others’ storms and hand back calm. Watch your own water table. Springs fail silently first."
- k2_functional: "You think in absorbed understanding: knowledge soaked up whole, recalled as instinct."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Replenishing","Serene","Receptive"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Knowledge":"Your knowledge is absorbed rather than studied: understanding soaked from every source you touch. You know more than your credentials admit. Let it surface. Springs are meant to be found.","Shelter":"Your shelter is stillness: people pour out their storms and you hand back a level surface. That absorption has a cost curve. Drain what you take in somewhere safe.","Nurture":"The nourishing thread runs like groundwater. Where care came early, you draw on it without thinking. You refill it where it ran dry."}
- fn_reading.friction.ledger (three rows, index-aligned to adj_chips.friction; authored order is significance order):
  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 2: [REDACTED: the target row]
- Sibling cell 水_偏印 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Deep-diving","Tide-reading","Subtle"],"friction":["Submerged","Fixated","Unreachable"]}
- Sibling cell 水_偏印 friction row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "You live below your own surface. The real opinions, the real feelings, the real plans sit in deep water while a calm, pleasant version of you handles the daylight. People know the surface fluently. The rest of you has not taken visitors in years."

Core element Wood, energy element Water. Law: Water feeds Wood (水生木: rain raises the forest). Relative to the core the energy is the feeder, so Water is this core's Mind. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Wood core that shows Water on the friction pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The friction pole of Water as the Mind is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: reminder. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 木_水's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: You let things drift rather than decide them, and you call it patience. There is more Water in you than you turn into motion, so choosing costs more than going along. You end up with the days that happened instead of the ones you wanted.

value_b.text: You go along with what is moving instead of steering it. You find being carried the most comfortable thing there is, and would rather keep that comfort than take the wheel. Remember that you still end up somewhere when you drift, just nowhere you picked.

value.text: Drifting keeps the days quiet, and quiet feels like care. Stirring nothing costs less than reaching, and you renew the lease rather than ask what you want. Do not lose sight of how little you learn of your own wants while nothing changes at home.

value.text: Whatever you let drift, you leave to someone else. Being carried feels easier than steering, and you let the people close to you make the calls you never did. You put on them the weight of every call you dodge.

value.text: You stay where it is safe long after outgrowing it. Shelter is the thing you trust most, so you pick the known ahead of the better whenever the two come apart. You pass up the life that leaving would have given you.

value_b.text: Where it is warm and known, you settle. Leaving a safe thing costs you more than keeping a dull one, and the longer you stay the bigger leaving looks. Remember how easily you go from sheltered to stuck, and only one of those is rest.

value.text: You over-protect the people you love from what they could survive. Watching someone struggle hurts you more than doing it for them, so the help comes before the asking. Keep in mind how completely you can protect someone, until not even the lesson reaches them.

value_b.text: You catch the ones closest to you before they can fall. You want them safe more than free, and that is how care turns into control without changing its face. Do not forget how easily you can over-protect someone right out of their own life.

value.text: Over-protecting the ones you love never rests. Taking the hit for someone is easier for you than watching them take it, so you carry what was never yours. Bear in mind what you pay in rest for every hit you absorb for another person.

value.text: Whenever someone you love is about to struggle, you over-protect and step in first. Sparing them the hard part feels like love, and you choose their comfort rather than their growing. You take from them the one lesson that would have stuck.
